notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Lead: LotusByte Labs (developer tools company building an IDE copilot for enterprise customers). Evaluating on-prem, must be air-gapped.
- Key ask: low-latency streaming to VSCode extension, model/version pinning per-team, deterministic fallbacks when hub unreachable.
- Packaging: prefer single tarball + offline package registry (no external container pull during install). Asked about signed artifacts and installer checksum validation.
- Hardware: initial ask = 4x H100 nodes (NVIDIA H100), later discussed 8x A100 alternative for cost parity. Wants Redwood guidance: GPU count, memory per model, recommended nvme for kv cache.
- Offline updates: must support staged bundle delivery (usb/drs), offline signature verification, and rollback. Legal wants SLA that offline update window <= 72h.
- Security: SOC2 + ISO27001 desirable; require SSO/SAML + SCIM, KMS integration (customer HSM), audit logging to internal SIEM, 7-year retention for code-related logs (negotiable).
- Perf targets: sub-150ms per-token for code completions, streaming chunk size 64 tokens, support for continuous batching but must not block interactive latency.
- Cost sensitivity: enterprise deal but focused on predictable CAPEX vs. monthly usage; leaning toward Dedicated/Private with fixed commit.
- Quote: "We need confidence that offline updates won't break pinned versions — can't have dev teams on different code-models diverge." — CTO paraphrase.
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (evaluation sponsor), Head of Developer Experience (owns POC success), Infra lead (install approvals).
- Next: send detailed hardware sizing doc + draft GTC for air-gapped support (Priya to own).
- Stubs: fireflies ff_2026-02-28_1324 (intro), ff_2026-03-04_0910 (security sync). Drive links above. Jira INF-4823 (packaging question), INF-4917 (installer bug discussion).
